method.timed_scope: Pretokenized padded arrays -> input device transfer -> synchronized forward -> four CPU logits; excludes tokenizer/cleaning, language gate, native transport and browser work.
method.inputs: English browser-fixture prose; concatenated passages exercise truncation; not an accuracy dataset
method.sampling: Evenly selected fixture paragraphs and concatenated passages, including padding and EOS-preserving truncation; no labeled accuracy corpus.
method.ordering: Sequential independent processes, deterministic backend order, no controlled cooldown or thermal/power measurement.
method.canonical_policy: First successful occurrence per backend/precision/shape/cache mode. Later MPS reference runs remain in repeated_references; failed pre-fix MLX loads remain in failed_attempts.
method.rss_scope: Fresh worker process including shared Transformers tokenizer/input-preparation imports and their dependencies; not a minimal deployed runtime footprint.
method.memory_note: Each case is a new process. Sampled RSS is not an exact peak. Device counters overlap unified RAM: do not add them. CoreML service allocations may not appear in client RSS.
method.timing_note: preprocessing_ms includes shared dependency/tokenizer initialization. load_or_compile_ms measures backend construction after input preparation; warmup is separate. Hash verification is outside these timers.
method.coreml_note: ORT CoreML MLProgram with ALL compute units and static shape overrides. Cold means empty experiment model cache, not a cold OS file cache. Cached sessions reuse that case cache. Profiling ends after warmup and before measured samples. CoreML EP plus CPU partitions is not proof of ANE-only execution. Graph FP32/FP16 is not proof of internal arithmetic precision.
method.mlx_note: Installed mlx-embeddings 0.1.0 XLM-RoBERTa embeddings+encoder unchanged; actual four-class RoBERTa dense/tanh/out_proj head. All keys/shapes loaded strictly after 98 legacy LayerNorm gamma/beta aliases map to weight/bias. Upstream explicit attention/FP32 softmax differs from Torch SDPA; this is an implementation comparison, not a framework ceiling.
method.parity_note: Engineering comparison against same-run, same-input MPS FP32 logits; argmax agreement is not detector accuracy or calibration evidence.
method.cache_policy: Delete only fresh per-case experiment cache after cold/cached pair. Failed cold initialization skips warm retry. Original weights and installed component untouched.
